titleText: University of Malta confers five honorary degrees
mainText: From Times of Malta: University of Malta confers five honorary degrees. Five distinguished people who left their mark in their respective fields receive honoris causa honours

titleText: 'Nanna' Christmas tree unveiled in Valletta ahead of festive celebrations
mainText: From Times of Malta: 'Nanna' Christmas tree unveiled in Valletta ahead of festive celebrations. The tree features around 10,000 ornaments, including 27 hand-painted decorations by local artists

titleText: Moveo reimagines ‘The Nutcracker’ at the Manoel
mainText: From Times of Malta: Moveo reimagines ‘The Nutcracker’ at the Manoel. The beloved Christmas Eve tale, accompanied by Tchaikovsky’s celebrated score, gets a fresh, contemporary interpretation from December 6 to 8

titleText: Who holds true power in this mad world?
mainText: From Times of Malta: Who holds true power in this mad world? Two absurdist plays challenge perceptions of power, authority, sanity and madness in Teatru Malta’s fifth and final ‘Għaxra’ double bill

titleText: Graffitti slam PA, Abela for 'facilitating theft of land' for padel courts
mainText: From Times of Malta: Graffitti slam PA, Abela for 'facilitating theft of land' for padel courts. The Lands Authority confirmed last week that Gżira United football club and its president Sharlon Pace have no form of title to the land in Manoel Island
